Künzle * This person is not on ResearchGate, or hasn't claimed this research yet. ## Abstract In this paper we study different models of the Teichmüller space of compact hyperbolic surfaces with special emphasis on their construction by geodesic octagons. Such surfaces have become increasingly interesting due to their applications to the physical behavior of chaotic quantum systems. They are, on the one hand, complex enough to show the relevant features, and on the other hand, they possess a simple mathematical structure allowing practical implementations. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- (PDF) Periodic orbits on the regular hyperbolic octagon (https://www.researchgate.net/publication/222376926_Periodic_orbits_on_the_regular_hyperbolic_octagon) citeturn3115search3 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: 2 weeks ago; DOI:10.1016/0167-2789(91)90053-C # Periodic orbits on the regular hyperbolic octagon * February 1991 * Physica D Nonlinear Phenomena 48(1):91-101 DOI:10.1016/0167-2789(91)90053-C Authors: Ralf Aurich * Ulm University Eugene Bogomolny * University of Paris-Sud Frank Steiner * Ulm University ## Abstract The length spectrum of closed geodesics on a compact Riemann surface corresponding to a regular octagon on the Poincaré disc is investigated.
